**STEP 3 - Items:** One red-yellow apple, whole and unpeeled. There is no sauce or other food.

**STEP 4 - Area:** The apple's footprint is π × 4² ≈ 50 cm², about 9% of the plate. Food covers about 9% of the plate in total.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** A whole apple has a density of about 0.85 g/ml, which includes the core and air pockets. 250 × 0.85 ≈ 210 g. A medium apple of 8 cm typically weighs about 180–200 g, so I'll use about 190 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Apple is about 52 kcal per 100 g. 190 g × 0.52 ≈ 99 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** One medium apple of about 190 g and about 100 kcal is plausible for what is visible.
